issues.title: Dangling Subfolder References
issues.why: The overview lists 15 subfolders (01-24), but the provided context only includes files for 00-overview and 01-cross-language. A mediocre AI cannot verify the 'CODE-RED' rules against the actual language specs (e.g., 05-rust/01-naming-conventions.md).
issues.fix: Provide the full content of all referenced subfolder overview and naming convention files.

issues.title: Legacy AC Scaffolds Lack Specificity
issues.why: The 'Legacy Index' in 97-acceptance-criteria.md explicitly states that table-row criteria are 'NO LONGER authoritative', yet many subfolders (TS, PHP, C#) currently have 0 GWT ACs, leaving the AI with no testable contract for those languages.
issues.fix: Backfill at least 5 GWT ACs for every language subfolder listed in the inventory.

issues.title: Incomplete Size Limit Enforcement Logic
issues.why: AC-CG-08 mandates 8-15 lines per function but does not define how to handle 'language-specific exceptions' mentioned in the text, leading to potential implementation inconsistency in Rust or Go.
issues.fix: Explicitly list the allowed exceptions for size limits within the normative YAML or TS contract blocks.
